questions.stem: At what level does every Priest learn Fear Ward in Forever?
questions.explanation: Every Priest learns Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at 20. Divine Spirit is baseline at 30 and Shadow Word: Death at 32.

questions.stem: Which Priest ability has its threat drop doubled in Forever?
questions.explanation: Fade's threat drop is doubled. Prayer of Healing now heals the target's party, and Flash Heal gained the Holy Binding self-heal.

questions.stem: Which of these Discipline talents is no longer in the Forever tree?
questions.explanation: Force of Will is gone, with Unbreakable Will, Improved Power Word: Fortitude and Divine Spirit. Soul Warding and Penance are new talents.

questions.stem: Which race's Priests unlock Desperate Prayer and Chastise through their class quests?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern lists Desperate Prayer and Chastise for Dwarves. Humans get Divine Grace and Feedback, Night Elves Starshards and Elune's Grace, Gnomes Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which boss drops the Eye of Divinity needed for Benediction?
questions.explanation: In Classic the Eye of Divinity comes from Majordomo Executus in Molten Core. Lord Kazzak is a source of the Eye of Shadow, and Eris Havenfire gives the Splinter of Nordrassil quest.

questions.stem: Which of these spells does every Priest race learn without a class quest?
questions.explanation: Fear Ward (with Devouring Plague) is baseline at level 20 for every race. Desperate Prayer, Starshards and Confounding Flash are racial spells from class quests.

questions.stem: At what level is Divine Spirit learned as a baseline spell?
questions.explanation: Divine Spirit comes at level 30 and Shadow Word: Death at 32. Fear Ward and Devouring Plague come at 20.

questions.stem: What does the Human racial give a Priest in the 26 Oct notes?
questions.explanation: Humans get +10% Spirit. +1% hit is the Dwarf's Artisan's Precision and +2% haste is the Skyborne's Wind-Blessed.

questions.stem: Which racial gives a Dwarf Priest +1% hit with spells and attacks?
questions.explanation: Artisan's Precision is the Dwarf racial. Ruthless is Human, Wind-Blessed is Skyborne and Eureka! is Gnome.

questions.stem: Which talent replaced Binding Heal?
questions.explanation: Blizzard replaced Binding Heal with Holy Binding. Prayer of Mending and Divine Aegis are separate new talents.

questions.stem: Which Classic Holy talent is gone from the Forever tree?
questions.explanation: Lightwell and Improved Prayer of Healing are gone. Improved Renew and Holy Reach are unchanged from Classic 1.12.

questions.stem: How many players does Onyxia's Lair take in Forever?
questions.explanation: Onyxia's Lair is a 40-player raid. Hyjal Summit takes 20 and The Barrow Deeps 10.

questions.stem: Which Priests can cast Fear Ward in Forever?
questions.explanation: Every Priest race has Fear Ward at 20, so Alliance raids no longer depend on Dwarf Priests for it.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much of a critical heal does a Divine Aegis shield absorb?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 shields 5% of the amount healed; rank 2 gives 10% and rank 3 gives 15%, up to 1,200 damage for 12 sec.

questions.stem: How long is Penance's cooldown?
questions.explanation: Penance is a 2 sec channel on a 12 sec cooldown. 3 min is Inner Focus's cooldown.

questions.stem: Renewed Hope adds crit chance to heals on targets with which effect?
questions.explanation: Renewed Hope works on targets with Weakened Soul, the effect your Power Word: Shield leaves. Holy Fire and Shadow Word: Pain are what Power in Light looks for.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much of your mana regeneration does Meditation keep going while you cast?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 keeps 17%; rank 2 keeps 33% and rank 3 keeps 50%.

questions.stem: Which Discipline talent reduces the threat your spells generate?
questions.explanation: Silent Resolve cuts spell threat by 10% per rank. Mental Agility lowers mana costs, Meditation keeps regeneration going and Martyrdom grants Focused Casting.

questions.stem: How much hit with Holy spells does Holy Precision give at most?
questions.explanation: Holy Precision gives 6% per rank, so 18% at rank 3. Blizzard added it so healing Priests can skip hit gear.

questions.stem: In Forever, which profession makes healing potions?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern says healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which flask is on the healer kit list?
questions.explanation: The Classic healer list starts with Flask of Distilled Wisdom. Flask of Supreme Power is on the caster list.

questions.stem: How many players does Hyjal Summit take?
questions.explanation: Hyjal Summit takes 20. The Barrow Deeps takes 10 and Onyxia's Lair 40.

questions.stem: At rank 3, how much less threat do your spells generate with Silent Resolve?
questions.explanation: Silent Resolve cuts spell threat by 10% per rank: 10% at rank 1, 20% at rank 2 and 30% at rank 3.

questions.stem: At rank 1, what chance does Martyrdom give you to gain Focused Casting after a melee or ranged crit hits you?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 gives a 50% chance; rank 2 makes it 100%.

questions.stem: What is Prayer of Mending's cooldown?
questions.explanation: Prayer of Mending has a 10 sec cooldown. It lasts 30 sec after each jump.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much of a heal's base cost does Litany of Light return?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 returns 5% of the base cost when your previous heal was a different spell; rank 2 returns 10%.

questions.stem: Holy Binding heals you when you cast which spell on someone else?
questions.explanation: Holy Binding heals you for 50% as much each time your Flash Heal heals someone else. Greater Heal and Lesser Heal do not trigger it.

questions.stem: At rank 1, what share of the damage does Blessed Recovery heal over 6 sec?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 heals 8% of the damage taken; rank 2 heals 17% and rank 3 heals 25%.

questions.stem: At rank 1, Spiritual Guidance raises your spell healing by up to what share of your total Spirit?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 adds healing up to 5% of your total Spirit (and spell damage up to 1%). Rank 5 raises the healing share to 25%.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which elixir is on the healer kit list?
questions.explanation: Elixir of the Sages is on the Classic healer list. Greater Arcane Elixir is on the caster list.

questions.stem: Which Priest spell heals the target's party, so you can heal a group you are not in?
questions.explanation: Prayer of Healing now heals the target's party. Fade is the threat drop, which is doubled in Forever.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much does Spell Warding reduce the spell damage you take?
questions.explanation: Spell Warding gives 2% per rank: 2% at rank 1, 4% at rank 2 and 10% at rank 5.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much longer does Improved Shadow Word: Pain make Shadow Word: Pain last?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 adds 3 sec; rank 2 adds 6 sec.

questions.stem: Which talent makes each Mind Flay tick deal more damage than the one before?
questions.explanation: Improved Mind Flay makes each tick deal 10% more than the last at rank 1. Dark Inspiration raises Spirit, and Improved Mind Blast shortens Mind Blast's cooldown.

questions.stem: At rank 1, what chance does each Shadow damage spell have to apply Shadow Weaving?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 gives a 33% chance, rank 2 67% and rank 3 100%. Each stack adds 2% to the Shadow damage the target takes from you, up to 5 stacks.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much cheaper does Devouring Contagion make Devouring Plague?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 cuts Devouring Plague's mana cost by 25%; rank 2 cuts it by 50%.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, how much spell hit did you need against bosses three levels higher?
questions.explanation: In Classic 1.12 the cap was 16% against bosses three levels higher, and 1% of spells always missed. Forever has no published value yet.

questions.stem: Which Shadow talent improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells?
questions.explanation: Shadow Focus adds 1% hit with Shadow spells per rank. Darkness adds damage, Shadow Reach adds range and Blackout adds a stun chance.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which flask is on the caster kit list?
questions.explanation: Flask of Supreme Power is on the Classic caster list. Flask of Distilled Wisdom is on the healer list.

questions.stem: At rank 1, how much Spirit does Dark Inspiration give you and your party?
questions.explanation: Rank 1 gives 3% for 10 sec, rank 2 gives 6% and rank 5 gives 15%.

questions.stem: How long does Silence stop the target from casting spells?
questions.explanation: Silence stops casting for 5 sec. 45 sec is its cooldown.

questions.stem: At rank 1, what chance does Blackout give your Shadow damage spells to stun the target?
questions.explanation: Blackout gives 2% per rank, for a 3 sec stun: 2% at rank 1, 4% at rank 2 and 10% at rank 5.
